title: Cold rebuild: read the crash and fix the config
summary: Fix a CrashLoopBackOff from its previous logs on a real cluster, from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a skill stuck. In *logs, exec and debug* you read a crashed container's last words with `--previous`
and fixed its ConfigMap, on a real cluster. Now do it again from memory: the same scenario, **no hints, no solution
to peek at**. The checks are exactly the ones you passed the first time.
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to
the lesson, then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.prompt: A pod is in `CrashLoopBackOff`. Which command shows the error that made it crash?
steps.explain: The current container has just restarted; the previous one holds the crash.

steps.title: Read the crash and fix the config, cold
prompt: This terminal runs a **real one-node Kubernetes 1.37 cluster** (k3s) with `kubectl` (alias `k`).
`api` is in `CrashLoopBackOff`. Write the error line its crashed container printed into `~/answers/fatal.txt`, fix the
ConfigMap `api-config` so the app finds the setting it needs (keeping the value), and replace the pod so it stays up.
From memory: no hints this time.
